SDSI is a Moroccan master programme in data science and intelligent systems that trains AI and data engineers for the Moroccan and Francophone tech ecosystem. Its admission page publishes the annual call, eligibility list and scholarship information for international and Moroccan applicants.

Programme Highlights

  • Morocco-based data science and AI master with international intake
  • Annual admission call with scholarship places for selected students
  • Curriculum spanning machine learning, big data and intelligent systems
  • Gateway to North African and European tech labour markets

Who Should Apply

Computer science, engineering, mathematics and statistics graduates are the target cohort; French and English both appear in programme materials.

Funding and Costs

Scholarship places and fee waivers for selected applicants are described in the annual call. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the SDSI admission page for the current call and submit through the application channel it specifies. Key deadline information: Annual call — the closing date for the next intake is published on the SDSI admission page.

Official Source

  • Official application page (verified link)

About SDSI Programme (Morocco)

SDSI is a Moroccan graduate programme in data science and intelligent systems delivered by a national university partnership, with an international student intake each year.

Official website: https://www.sdsi.ma

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: Annual call - see official page - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
